comparison.objective: Feed a pine board or plank through a table saw with push sticks to complete a rip or cross-cut safely.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual workpiece feeding and stabilization under cutting reaction while maintaining blade clearance.
comparison.success_condition: Cut completed at the required dimension, pieces flat and still, hands clear, with proximity, kick-up, or loss causing zero; all six rip/cross-cut versions were considered.
comparison.reason: The record tests coordinated feed-force control and saw safety, not locking and verifying an adjustable robot-gripper stop.
